events.title: US-Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The US-Iran conflict is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The conflict is also affecting US-China trade relations.
events.reasoning: The conflict is likely to lead to increased oil prices, which could boost the US stock market. However, emerging markets may be negatively affected due to their dependence on oil imports.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US-Iran conflict developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/barrel or if the US-Iran conflict de-escalates

events.title: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Decision
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady, but may hike rates later this year. This could lead to increased volatility in the bond market and affect the US dollar.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: Invesco PowerShares DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund (UUP)

events.reasoning: The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady may lead to a decrease in the US dollar and an increase in bond prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor inflation data and Fed speeches

events.exitStrategy: Exit if the Fed hikes interest rates or if inflation data exceeds expectations

gains.extendedNote: If the Fed cuts interest rates
